source: Real, on goose 1.57.0 (`goose acp`) with an OpenRouter key (login way openrouterKey, model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash), driven through weft's own agent server and this spec, every line teed (scratchpad acp12/drive.py, acp12/goose/transcript.jsonl): hello, tool (the program's lookup over HTTP MCP, asked and allowed) and permission (`touch made.txt`, allowed); it streams its thinking a token per chunk. Earlier, against a local fake OpenAI-compatible model (login way openaiCompatible), every line teed (scratchpad goose/real.jsonl, goose/real3.jsonl, goose/real4.jsonl): initialize line 3, session/new line 5, session/set_mode line 10, session/load line 129 with its replay lines 115-128 before and 130-131 after; reject lines 35-76 (reject_once, line 39); bad key, real4.jsonl lines 9-10 (the fake model answering 401); provider error, real3.jsonl lines 9-10 (the fake model answering 400). Nothing is composed.
